posts.tagline: Prayer Times & Adhan Notifications for Muslims
posts.description: Prayer Times Notification is a lightweight Chrome extension built for Muslims. 🕌 Get accurate daily prayer times based on your location, see a live countdown to the next prayer, receive desktop notifications, and enable optional Adhan sounds. 🌍 Available in 14 languages, it's designed to help Muslims stay connected to their daily prayers while working, studying, or browsing online. Free, simple, and easy to use.

posts.name: IO Inventory
posts.tagline: Keep track of everything in your dev environment
posts.description: IO Inventory maps your local development environment in one place. Scan packages, runtimes, repositories, containers, local models, MCP servers, and AI-agent tooling, then explore everything through an interactive architecture graph. Search what’s installed, understand where it came from, track changes with snapshots, and manage supported packages without jumping between dozens of commands and config files. 100% local. No telemetry. Open source.

posts.name: Snifter
posts.tagline: See every cocktail you can make with the bottles you own
posts.description: Add your bottles by describing them in plain words or snapping your shelf — parsed on-device. Snifter instantly shows every classic you can make right now, plus which single bottle unlocks the most new drinks — that hint is free, not paywalled. 78 classics with exact, bartender-accurate measures. Works offline; your bottles and logs stay on your device, with no account. One-time $4.99 unlocks the AI input and your drink log — no subscription, no ads.

posts.name: Better Call Salon
posts.tagline: Online salon bookings without phone tag or marketplace fees
posts.description: Salon booking software for independent salons. Let clients self-schedule, hold a card for no-show protection, and sync every appointment with Google Calendar.

posts.name: GateBuddy
posts.tagline: ASK • HELP • DONE | Verified campus student platform
posts.description: GateBuddy is a verified campus student platform that helps university students connect for gate pickups, parcel collection, food pickups, and everyday campus assistance. Students verify their identity using their university email, creating a trusted campus-only community. GateBuddy aims to make student life more convenient by enabling quick, secure, and reliable peer-to-peer support within universities.

posts.name: Oxta Chat
posts.tagline: ChatGPT,Themes
posts.description: Restyle ChatGPT with immersive themes — retro CRT, sci-fi terminal, vintage monitor, and more.

posts.name: TeraAirlift
posts.tagline: Send massive files, with no size or bandwidth restrictions.
posts.description: TeraAirlift is a desktop file transfer platform built for teams moving massive files and datasets. Send, receive, track, and manage large transfers without the complexity of traditional cloud storage. Designed for video production, LiDAR, construction, VFX, 3D scanning, and other data-heavy workflows where tools like WeTransfer and Dropbox start to fall short.

posts.name: Leakly
posts.tagline: Infostealer Log & Dark Web Credential Monitoring
posts.description: Stop unmonitored credential leaks. Leakly.io continuously tracks Infostealer malware dumps (Lumma, RedLine) to identify exposed accounts, session tokens, and compromised platforms before attackers exploit them.

posts.name: Gotcha
posts.tagline: World's First AI Copilot for Android. You talk. It acts.
posts.description: Control your Android phone using natural language. Gotcha is a free, open-source on-device AI copilot featuring 100+ native device tools, dual safety modes, and real-time voice calls over any app, powered by Samosa AIR (LLM, STT, and TTS).

posts.name: Clamshell
posts.tagline: Close your MacBook. Keep the work running.
posts.description: Closing my MacBook used to kill whatever I had left running: a build, a download, sometimes an agent halfway through a task. I made Clamshell to fix that. The lid shuts, the screen goes dark, and the work carries on. No monitor, sudo, or admin setup.

posts.name: VF TV — Free Live TV
posts.tagline: Stream movies and shows for free, right in your browser.
posts.description: Built a free streaming web app where you can watch movies and shows right in your browser. No downloads, no installs, just open the site and hit play.

posts.name: OopsSubs
posts.tagline: Find & Cancel Forgotten Subscriptions
posts.description: OopsSubs is a subscription manager. OopsSubs helps you find and cancel forgotten subscriptions. OopsSubs scans your Gmail to discover every subscription you're paying for, reminds you before renewal, and helps you cancel with step-by-step guides.

posts.name: FORGE Coach AI
posts.tagline: Your AI coach that turns business ideas into action plans
posts.description: Most AI business tools give generic advice. FORGE is different: it interviews you like a real coach — your situation, budget, taxes, competition — then builds a step-by-step action plan broken into concrete micro-missions, not just tips. Each mission needs real proof (a photo or screenshot) before you unlock the next one. 98% of people with a business idea never start. FORGE is built to force the other 2% into action.

posts.name: LinkMails
posts.tagline: AI-powered email outreach that gets replies
posts.description: Managing multilingual client emails shouldn't eat up hours of your day. LinkMails uses autonomous AI agents to categorize, translate, and draft context-aware replies directly in your inbox. Key capabilities: • Auto-sorts inquiries, orders, & complaints • Real-time translation (8+ languages) • Human-sounding, personalized draft replies with customer memory No templates or robotic copy—just AI handling the routine work so you only review what matters. We’d love your feedback!

posts.name: InvoAIce
posts.tagline: AI-powered invoicing for freelancers and small businesses
posts.description: InvoAIce helps freelancers and small businesses create professional invoices in seconds using AI. Generate invoices from text or voice, customize them with your branding, export beautiful PDFs, track payments and manage clients.

posts.name: Tideway
posts.tagline: The all-in-one back office for creative freelancers.
posts.description: Tideway runs the whole business for independent creatives. Capture every billable hour, hold the line on scope creep, send branded invoices that get paid faster, and see real profit per project. One tool instead of six. The money you make is the money you keep. Launching August 2026.

posts.name: Nipsole - Ai teacher
posts.tagline: Learn anything on an AI whiteboard
posts.description: Nipsole turns any topic into an interactive visual lesson. Explore expandable mind maps, watch AI teach on a hand-drawn whiteboard, or solve math problems step by step with the reasoning explained alongside the work.

posts.name: Vizard Agent
posts.tagline: One AI agent for every kind of video
posts.description: Vizard Agent is a general AI video agent built to take on the whole video job. Start with raw footage, an existing video, a URL, a script, an image, or just an idea. Tell it what you want to make, and it figures out the work in between, from editing and generation to repurposing, localization, and revisions. Instead of managing a different tool for every step, you give one agent the outcome you want and work with it until the video is finished.

posts.name: VectorDarts
posts.tagline: Play. Practice. Compete
posts.description: VectorOS is the all-in-one platform for darts players to score matches, track stats, practice with purpose, compete, and manage leagues. Built by a passionate darts player, VectorOS brings everything together in one modern experience to help players improve and grow the game. Join our early access community and help shape the future of darts.

posts.name: Octomind Cloud + Hub
posts.tagline: One login, zero API keys — cloud agents + 27 models
posts.description: Run AI agents in the cloud — pick a machine, tell it what to do, close your laptop. Sessions resume from any device. Per-second billing, 21 models built in, no API keys. Solved 24/25 benchmark tasks — ahead of Claude Code and Codex.

posts.name: CareerVivid
posts.tagline: AI-Powered Interactive Interview & Career Prep Studio
posts.description: Build job-ready skills with interactive courses in AI agents, coding interview patterns, and system design — then prepare for interviews at 300+ companies and tailor your resume to any role.

posts.name: CostPerPrompt
posts.tagline: Live AI API pricing + calculators that model real workloads
posts.description: Stop guessing your AI bill. CostPerPrompt tracks live prices for 292 AI models (GPT, Claude, Gemini, Kimi, DeepSeek…) and turns them into real answers: what your chatbot, RAG pipeline, agent, or voice AI costs per month — with prompt caching and batch discounts modeled in. Plus GPU rental comparison across 10 providers, 9 practical cost guides, and a private in-browser token counter. Free, no signup, prices refresh daily.

posts.name: PAYgrade
posts.tagline: A job structure you can defend to anyone
posts.description: Job evaluation software with consistent grading, automatic anomaly detection, and evidence-backed decisions. This system provides a extensive framework for creating, managing, and defending organisational pay structures and job hierarchies, using clear, standardised criteria such as role complexity, responsibility, and organisational context.
